description:
Project Overview

This Wageningen doctorate examines the militarization of societal resilience: how preparations for crisis and war reshape relationships between civilian institutions, communities and military actors.

Research Position Overview

Combine critical military and resilience studies with qualitative empirical research and policy analysis. The project is hosted by Sociology of Development and Change and considers the political and social consequences of changing civil–military arrangements.

Research Areas

  • Militarization
  • Societal resilience
  • Qualitative research
